r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Evidence regenerates and matches DIAGNOSIS.md to the digit. (a) genuinely rejected: lap-length delta 15.1m/3241.6m=0.47%; true-dist re-registration via np.interp(grid_dist, driver_distance, driver_speed) does NOT lower ratios — braking regime mean 1.884->1.870 (-0.7%, noise), fast_corner 1.994 both ways; C2 braking knee true-dist ratio goes UP (1.22->2.0), the reverse of what (a) predicts. (b) genuinely confirmed: tunnel cap ~16 m/s (57 km/h) vs VER 63 m/s; required a_lat 44 m/s2 (4.5g) vs model-supplied ~5 m/s2 (0.5g). Real evidence, not artifact.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: Inherited Physics-And-Units rule (CREW_CONTEXT lines 74-84): units must be explicit. The diagnosis is units-rigorous in its own arithmetic. Canonical ideal-lap path used (no reinvented sim). Diagnosis correctly states the cap formula direction. ONE quality gap: DIAGNOSIS.md writes v_cap=sqrt(A0/(kappa-A2)) dropping the air-density rho on the A2 term that the real code (physics_simulator denom=curvature-A2*air_density) carries — immaterial to the verdict (rho effect ~19% on the tiny A2 term; cap is A0-dominated) but should be noted. The diagnosis's ROOT-CAUSE ATTRIBUTION ('cross-session pool dilutes A0') is asserted, not verified, and the probe (r6) shows it is WRONG.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: The probe finding RE-SCOPES the issue and adds a decision candidate on decision:ideal_lap_sim_two_sided_evaluator: a lateral units/assembly bug (g-coefficient consumed as m/s2) parallel to the #518 G5 watts/W-kg fix. Implementer's Map Impact correctly flagged the (b) verdict and routed the A0 question to the decide-fix checkpoint, but its attribution ('cross-circuit pool artifact / Monaco diluted by high-speed tracks') is materially WRONG — every per-session A0 is ~2-5, Monaco's own is 2.626. This must reach Cartographer/decide-fix as 'units bug', not 'pooling'. Flagged as triage candidate.

r6-probe.title: Scope-determining probe: units vs measurement vs pooling
r6-probe.imperative: Resolve whether A0~2.64 lateral under-call is a units/assembly bug, a measurement under-call, or pooling dilution. Pull raw per-session RBR A0/A2; sanity-check scale; run LateralView.fit on VER Monaco.
r6-probe.finding: CONCLUSION: UNITS/ASSEMBLY BUG (not pooling, not measurement under-call). (1) Raw per-session: all 22 RBR 2023-Q A0 values are 1.87-4.91 (Monaco own 2.626, pooled 2.642) — NO session has a high A0 the pool could dilute. Pooling-dilution REFUTED. (2) Source LateralView (lateral_view.py L1-6,66-72) defines A0/A2 as a grip COEFFICIENT in g-units (mu); a_lat_max=(A0+A2 v^2)*g. de-conflation mu_obs=|a_lat|/(g cos theta) divides out g. But consumer LateralParameters.lateral_capability (physics_data_models.py L237-249) computes mechanical=A0*g_track, aero=A2*rho*v^2 with NO *9.81 -> reads g-coeff as m/s2. Dominant error = missing *9.81 on BOTH terms (clean multiplicative gap = the #518 G5 tell); secondary = spurious *rho on the aero term. (3) Direct LateralView.fit on VER Monaco: A0=3.20, raw p99=4.62g. Under g-coeff reading -> 32-41 m/s2 (3.3-4.2g) PHYSICAL; under m/s2 reading -> 0.34-0.42g absurd. Applying *g: tunnel cap=65.9 m/s (237 km/h) vs VER actual 63.3 — match within 4%. The *9.81 fully closes the gap. Braking(a_b~27 m/s2) and traction(a_t) are natively m/s2 and read correctly; lateral is the lone mis-scaled channel. => SMALL FIX (units), not capability rebuild.

triage_candidates.statement: Lateral grip units bug: LateralView emits A0/A2 as g-coefficient (mu); LateralParameters.lateral_capability + physics_simulator consume them as m/s2 (no *9.81) and apply a spurious *rho on the aero term. Fix = multiply by g=9.81 and drop rho on aero (or rescale at store boundary), then re-baseline ideal-lap. Parallels #518 G5. Verify blast radius: braking_grip_ratio/traction_grip_ratio fallbacks also multiply lateral_capability.
